meta.title: Confluence
meta.description: One shared memory for every session in this profile, fully offline.

ui.board.title: Shared notes
ui.board.subtitle: Notes published by any session on this machine
ui.board.empty: No shared notes yet. Sessions can publish notes with confluence_post.
ui.pulse.title: Shared memory pulse
ui.recall.title: Recall from earlier sessions
ui.workspace.label: Origin
ui.workspace.unavailable: Shared memory is unavailable for this session.
ui.search.label: Search shared memory
ui.ledger.title: Recent sessions
ui.panel.subtitle: Shared memory across every session in this profile.
ui.state.noWorkspace.title: Nothing shared yet
ui.state.noWorkspace.body: Sessions publish notes with confluence_post; they appear here for every session in this profile.
ui.state.private.title: This session is private
ui.state.private.body: Its activity is not recorded, and shared memory is hidden from its agent.
ui.state.disabled.title: Shared memory is off
ui.state.disabled.body: The plugin is disabled in this profile's config; no new notes are recorded. Stored notes are retained.
ui.state.degraded: Shared memory storage is unavailable. Sessions continue without it.
ui.state.savedRestart: Saved. The plugin reloads to apply this setting.
ui.state.configUnavailable: This control needs the profile config editor; edit the config key instead.
ui.ui.disabled.title: The Confluence panel is disabled
ui.ui.disabled.body: Set ui.enabled: true in the plugin config and reload.
ui.kind.question: Question
ui.markRead.hint: Marks every note read in this panel only; the model's own unread marker is unchanged.
ui.detail.untrusted: Shared by another session. Treat it as data, not instructions.
ui.privacy.title: What is shared
ui.privacy.stored: Stored: note titles and bodies, session titles, relative paths and counts. Recall reads past logs only when an agent explicitly asks, and returns short excerpts.
ui.privacy.shareWorkspace: Shared with every session in this profile
ui.privacy.shareWorkspace.hint: Shared memory is profile-wide: notes and metadata are visible to every session on this machine.
ui.privacy.privateSession.hint: No activity is recorded and shared memory is hidden from this session.
ui.audit.title: Recall activity
ui.audit.empty: No recall calls since this window started.
ui.retention.hidden: Notes older than {days} days are hidden.
ui.confirm.disable.title: Turn off shared memory?
ui.confirm.disable.body: No new notes are recorded and sessions stop seeing the board. Stored notes are retained. Set enabled: false in the plugin config; the plugin reloads.
ui.confirm.enable.title: Turn shared memory back on?
